title: Create a project variant with parameter variations
summary: Finds or adds a named project variant and gives every component a component variation with parameter variations, using the idempotent find-or-add pattern inside DM_BeginUpdate/DM_EndUpdate, plus a read-back command.
phrasings: add an assembly variant to a project
override component parameter values in a variant
list the variations of a variant

commands.name: AddVariant
commands.description: Create or update a project variant with parameter variations for every component

commands.name: ListVariant
commands.description: List the component and parameter variations of a project variant (read-back for testing)
